mentions.name: Sphinx
mentions.description: A browser extension that blocks distracting sites (like X, Reddit, and Hacker News) until the user solves a problem, aiming to break the reflexive doomscrolling habit and provide mild cognitive benefit from working through the challenges.
mentions.problem: The author spends too much time doomscrolling on social sites and feels AI is eroding basic skills like coding and math; the extension blocks the reflex of visiting a site for a dopamine hit.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built an extension that blocks sites and forces you to actually solve a problem before you can get to a distracting site. The idea is to 1) block the reflex of visiting a site and getting a dopamine hit, and 2) at least get some mild cognitive benefit from it. I use it myself.
mentions.author: hackitup7
